jobs.occupation: Sr KAM Off Trade - Non food company
jobs.description:
The company is a leading international FMCG player in the non-food sector, offering a diverse portfolio of trusted consumer products across categories such as personal care, household, and lifestyle essentials. Known for its strong brands, innovation-driven mindset, and commitment to sustainability, it combines global scale with local market expertise. The organization places a strong emphasis on quality, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement, making it a dynamic and forward-thinking environment within the fast-moving consumer goods industry.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior KAM, you will be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of key retail accounts, developing tailored commercial strategies to drive distribution, visibility, and long-term profitable growth. You will act as the primary point of contact for your customers, ensuring strong partnerships and flawless execution in the market.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and develop strategic relationships with key off-trade customers in the non-food channel.
• Negotiate annual agreements, pricing, and promotional plans to deliver sustainable growth.
• Develop and execute joint business plans aligned with customer and company objectives.
• Drive distribution, shelf presence, and visibility of product ranges across retail partners.
• Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer performance to identify opportunities.
• Collaborate closely with marketing, supply chain, and category teams to ensure execution excellence.
• Deliver against sales, profitability, and market share targets.
• Provide regular performance analysis and strategic recommendations to senior management.

• Proven experience in Key Account Management within FMCG, preferably in non-food or general merchandise.
• Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation skills.
• Ability to build long-term, trust-based relationships with retail partners.
• Analytical mindset with strong understanding of sales data and category performance.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive, and results-oriented approach.
• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Fluent in French, Dutch and English.

The company is a fast-growing food retail chain known for offering high-quality, fresh, and convenient food options at accessible prices. With a strong focus on customer experience, operational efficiency, and product consistency, it operates a network of locations designed to serve customers on-the-go while maintaining strong brand standards and a welcoming atmosphere.

Jobomschrijving

As District Manager, you will be responsible for the overall performance of multiple stores, ensuring consistent execution of commercial strategies, operational standards, and brand values. You will act as a strategic partner to Store Managers, supporting them in achieving strong business results while fostering a culture of engagement and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and support Store Managers to deliver strong sales, profitability, and operational performance.
• Monitor and analyze key performance indicators, driving corrective actions when needed.
• Ensure consistent implementation of brand standards, food quality, and customer experience.
• Develop and coach teams to build a high-performance and customer-focused culture.
• Optimize operational processes, staffing, and cost efficiency across the district.
• Collaborate with Head Office teams on promotions, merchandising, and business initiatives.
• Identify local market opportunities to drive growth and customer loyalty.
• Ensure compliance with health, safety, and food hygiene regulations.

• Proven experience in multi-site management within food retail, QSR, hospitality, or FMCG retail.
• Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop teams at scale.
• Commercially minded with a strong focus on KPIs and results.
• Hands-on, pragmatic, and comfortable in a fast-moving environment.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Passion for food, customer experience, and operational excellence.
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English.

Jobomschrijving

What are your responsibilities as a forklift driver?
	
• Receiving and correctly storing incoming goods in the warehouse	
• Loading and unloading trucks	
• Scanning products in and out using a scanning system	
• Operating a forklift (approximately 80% of the time) and an electric pallet truck (approximately 20%)	
• Maintaining a clean, safe, and organized workplace	
• Working in a chilled environment with a closed and heated forklift

	
• You hold a valid forklift certificate	
• You have experience stacking and working at heights of up to 10 meters	
• You speak Dutch, French, or English	
• You work accurately and value order and structure	
• Safety is always your top priority	
• You enjoy working independently but also function well within a team

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

What will you be doing?

During the season:

You will be part of a dynamic, energetic team that processes 45 tons of carrots per hour. Together with your colleagues, you will:

• Monitoring the operation of machines (conveyor belts, scanners, cutting and packaging systems)
• Check quality and make changes when necessary
• Show initiative and make quick decisions in difficult situations
• Detecting faults, responding immediately to breakdowns and making quick operational decisions
• Making settings and quality improvements
• Seasonal maintenance, minor repairs, and support for the maintenance department – replacing belts, lubrication, sensor adjustment, filter checks, etc.
• Working in accordance with health and safety and hygiene regulations

Out of season:

You will assist with maintenance and repairs to keep our equipment in top condition. This is not a lab job—you will be working on robust washing and sorting lines, not delicate machines in clean rooms. Practical knowledge and hands-on skills are essential.

• Solid technical knowledge and a proactive approach
• Good command of English allowing for effective communication
• Experience working with loaders or forklifts is a plus
• You enjoy working outdoors and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty
• You are responsible, independent, and solution-oriented
• Flexibility to support other departments during quieter periods
• During the high season (July, August, September), it is not possible to take vacation

jobs.occupation: La Lorraine Bakery Group - Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
At Llbg, our core business processes depend on seamless integrations between SAP, cloud applications, data platforms, customers and suppliers. As an Integration Engineer, you play a key role in designing, building and supporting the integrations and automations that connect these systems.

Working primarily with Workato, you help ensure our critical business processes run efficiently, reliably and securely. You combine technical expertise with a problem-solving mindset and contribute to scalable, future-proof solutions that support our continued growth and digital transformation.
Function

• You design, build, test, deploy and support enterprise integrations and process automations on the Workato platform.

• You translate business requirements into reliable and scalable integration solutions while adhering to Llbg's architecture and integration standards.

• You integrate SAP applications with many other business-critical systems such as Microsoft 365, cloud applications, data platforms and external B2B interfaces

• You monitor integration flows, handle incidents, perform root cause analyses and continuously improve solutions to ensure stable business operations.

• You develop and maintain reusable components, technical documentation, test scenarios and operational procedures that support long-term maintainability.

• You collaborate closely with architects, developers, business analysts and external partners to deliver scalable, sustainable and supportable solutions.

• You contribute to the further development of intelligent automation and AI-enabled solutions, ensuring they are secure, reliable and deliver measurable business value.

• You help drive continuous improvement of the integration platform by promoting best practices, identifying optimization opportunities and contributing to reusable standards and governance.

• As Integration Engineer you will report to the Integration Architect.

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business Engineering or a related field, or have gained equivalent experience.

• You have an affinity with, and basic understanding of integration concepts through study, internship, personal projects, or professional experience.

• Prior exposure to an iPaaS platform (Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, SAP Integration Suite, Azure Integration Services) is a strong plus but not required.

• You have some familiarity with at least a few of the following, and are eager to deepen your knowledge on the job:

• Integration principles and patterns (sync/async communication, event-driven architecture)

• API technologies (REST, SOAP, GraphQL)

• Security concepts (authentication, authorization, API security)

• Data formats and transformation (JSON, XML, CSV, data mapping)

• Monitoring, logging, and error handling in system integrations

• You can communicate fluently in English and Dutch.

• You enjoy working with both technical and business stakeholders in an international environment.

jobs.occupation: La Lorraine Bakery Group - Junior Data Engineer (Production & Supply Chain)
jobs.description:
As a Junior Data Engineer - Production & Supply Chain, you help transform operational data into reliable and actionable insights. You contribute to data products, data models, and data pipelines that support reporting, Power BI, Machine Learning, and AI applications.

Working with data from ERP, MES, WMS, and other operational systems, you learn how to structure, integrate, and make data accessible across the organization. Together with BI/RT Solution Partners, Data Scientists, IT teams, and business stakeholders, you help build solutions that improve decision-making across production, planning, inventory, logistics, and quality.
Function

• You support the design, development, testing, and documentation of ETL/ELT data pipelines that transform operational data into reliable datasets for BI, analytics, Machine Learning, and AI.

• You contribute to the integration of data from production and supply chain systems such as ERP, MES, WMS, and other operational applications.

• You help build data products and semantic models covering topics such as production performance, forecasting, inventory management, Otif, planning, traceability, and logistics efficiency.

• You perform data quality checks, investigate data issues, and contribute to maintaining accurate documentation, monitoring, and data lineage.

• You learn and apply modern data engineering practices, including Version Control, testing, CI/CD, and DataOps.

• You work in an agile environment alongside data analysts, data scientists, IT colleagues, and business stakeholders, gradually developing into a well-rounded data professional.

You report directly to the Data & Analytics Platform Architect.

• You hold a Master's degree in IT, Data, Engineering, or a related field.

• You have gained relevant experience through internships, academic projects, or an initial professional experience.

• You have a solid foundation in SQL and Python and are eager to further develop your expertise in modern cloud data platforms such as Azure and Databricks.

• You are interested in data modelling, ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, lakehouse architectures, testing, and documentation. Experience with DBT or similar frameworks is considered a plus.

• You are analytical, detail-oriented, and eager to learn. You enjoy understanding how business processes work and how high-quality data supports better decision-making.

• You are comfortable using AI tools to work more efficiently, accelerate learning, and support innovative solutions.

• You communicate fluently in English and enjoy collaborating with both technical teams and business stakeholders. Knowledge of Dutch a plus.
